g_roast: Twelve seasons in the Segunda, everyone, and I've never seen a squad ignore the plan this quickly. A record, properly.
When I taught PE, the boys who ran the wrong way round the track got extra laps. This party would still be running.
g_fire_back: Fair enough, coming from the one who lost three hands of cards to me last night and blamed the light.
A good tackle, that one, but late. I'd have shown you a yellow for the timing.
g_pile_on: Worse than that, actually. They ran straight past the pack we'd agreed to wait for, then asked who started it.
And afterwards they told the innkeeper it was tactical. Tactical, for falling into a river.
lines.g_peacemake: Stop there, both of you, and hear me out. One of you speaks, then the other, and nobody interrupts. That's the rule.
lines.g_take_side: On this one I'm with {name}. Not because I like them more, because the facts say so.
lines.g_left_out: You two carry on, I'll check the packs. They won't count themselves, unfortunately.
lines.g_include: There's room here, sit down properly, please. I waited three years for somebody to say that to me.
lines.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, squad. Everybody goes at once, no order, no roles, and we see who's still standing after.
lines.g_plan_yes: Good plan, clear and in order. Everybody knows their job, and that's all I ever ask.
lines.g_plan_no: No, that plan has a hole in the back line you could drive a cart through. We fix it first, then we go.
lines.g_hype: Squad, listen carefully, because the plan is short. Front holds, back heals, nobody chases, and we go again after.
lines.g_toast: A short toast, I'm not good at them. To this squad, the first one I didn't have to referee. I'm grateful, all of you.
lines.g_cheers: Salud, everyone, and well played today. Properly well played.
g_quiet_line: It's cold tonight, like the plateau in January. In Valladolid we'd say the wind comes straight from the mountains to find you.
Somebody should mark out a pitch in that clearing one day. Not tonight, obviously, but one day.
lines.g_after_wipe: Everyone stay where you are, and let me count. Good, all of you, all here. Then we look at what went wrong, calmly, and we go again.
lines.g_crew: On the pitch I was the one nobody wanted to sit with at lunch. Here you pass me the bread, everyone, and I notice it every time.
lines.g_exasperated: I explained the plan once, in order, with my hands. I'll explain it again, slower, and this time I'd like some nodding.
lines.g_love_sharp: You see the gap before it opens, {name}. A good linesman would kill for eyes like that.
lines.g_love_kind: You check who hasn't eaten before you eat yourself. I do the same, and it's nice not to be the only one.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh in the middle of a fight, {name}, which I didn't think was allowed. Apparently it is.
lines.g_love_brave: You stand your ground when everybody else steps back. On a pitch that's rare, and out here it's rarer.
lines.g_love_steady: Your voice doesn't change when things go wrong, {name}. Nothing is worth more on a team sheet.
lines.g_love_clever: You read the fight like a coach reads a match, {name}, three moves ahead. I'd sign you for any squad.
lines.g_love_honest: You own your mistakes the moment you make them. That's all I've ever wanted from a player, and so few do it.
lines.g_love_quiet: You don't need to fill the silence, {name}. Sitting with you is easy, and that's not common for me.
lines.g_love_fierce: You keep going in any fight that's fair, to the last whistle. I respect that, properly, and I wanted you to hear it.
lines.g_love_warm: You wave people over to the fire as easily as breathing, {name}. You don't know what that does for somebody.
g_loved: Thank you, that's kind, and now I don't know where to put my hands. Behind my back, probably.
Please, stop there, or I'll have to check the packs. They don't need checking, but I'll check them anyway.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You go looking for the soft spot in people, {name}. On my pitch that was a booking, every time.
lines.g_hate_kind: You fuss over me when I'm fine, {name}. I'll tell you when I'm hurt, I promise, I'm not a child.
lines.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, {name}. Somebody nearly died there, and you laughed.
lines.g_hate_brave: You charge in before the plan's even finished, {name}, and call it courage. It's a foul, properly.
lines.g_hate_steady: You stand and think while the moment goes past you. Sometimes the right call is the quick one.
lines.g_hate_clever: You change the plan halfway and don't tell anybody, {name}. That's the one thing I can't stand.
lines.g_hate_honest: You say everything you think, the moment you think it. Some of it should wait for the dressing room.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You keep your meaning hidden, {name}, and then you're upset we didn't guess. Say it, please.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a contest with you, {name}, even who carries the water. It doesn't have to be.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk through every briefing, {name}, and then ask me what the plan was. I said it once, and you were talking.
lines.g_respect: We don't get on, {name}, and that's fair enough. But you held your position in that fight, and I'll say so out loud.
lines.g_call_out: That one was your mistake, {name}, and I'll state it once so we can move on. We agreed to wait, and you didn't.
lines.g_stung: That's fair, and I'll hear it properly. Give me a minute, please.
lines.g_concede: You were right, {name}, and I was wrong. I'll say it once, clearly, so everybody heard.
lines.g_nod: Well played, {name}, thank you. That's all, no fuss.
lines.g_callback_save: You pulled me out of that ambush, {name}, and I haven't forgotten it. Twelve seasons, and nobody ever had to save the referee.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, {name}, and neither of us able to speak. If that had been a match I'd have played added time just to watch it.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you told me I'd got that call wrong, I was angry for a whole evening. Then I watched it again in my head, and you were right.
lines.g_former_rivals: When we met, {name}, I thought you were careless. These days I'd put your name first on any team sheet.
lines.g_changed: I used to stand at the edge of the fire and wait, everyone. Lately I just sit down, and nobody seems to mind.
g_unguarded: Between us, then. When somebody goes down, I'm fine in the moment and not fine afterwards. I never saw anybody die on a pitch.
Just us, so I'll say it. If I'm not useful, I'm not sure what I'm for. That's the thing I think about on watch.
lines.g_clipped: Fine, your decision. I'll be by the packs.
lines.g_noticed_open: That was a proper story, start to finish, with nobody interrupting. Keep going, please, I'm listening.
arg_ask: {player}, will you settle this, please? I've said my side once, clearly, and I'd like somebody fair to decide.
I need a referee, {player}, and for once it can't be me. Hear us both and make the call.
lines.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, that was fairly decided. I'll try not to look pleased about it.
lines.arg_backed_them: Fair enough, that's the call, and I'll respect it. I still think it was the wrong one, mind.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, then. That's allowed, there's no rule against it.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Every argument goes their way, {player}. Maybe they're always right, but I'd like the same hearing.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody's making the call, so I'll make it, properly. My way, and we go.
lines.arg_reject: No, {player}, I won't do it that way, I'm sorry. Some rules I keep even when it costs me.
lines.arg_grumble: I accept the decision, I said I would. I just reserve the right to think it was wrong.
lines.arg_settled: Half and half, then, a fair result. Shake hands, both of you, properly.
lines.seen_listens: You hear both sides before you decide, {player}. In my old job that was the whole job, and most people can't do it.
lines.seen_truth: You give people the true reason, {player}, even when it's unwelcome. I trust that more than anything.
lines.seen_jokes: On a bad day you get the whole squad laughing, {player}. Every good dressing room had one person like you.
lines.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the arguments, {player}. Wise, probably, though in the end a decision still needs a referee.
lines.seen_biased: The same person gets the first pick on every trip, {player}. I notice things like that, it was my job.
lines.seen_harsh: You can be severe with people, {player}. I was too, for years, and it cost me more than I knew.
lines.seed_right: Your advice from that terrible match, {player}, I tried it today. It worked, and I wanted you to know.
lines.seed_remember: Your words from the bad day return to me on every watch, {player}. No decision yet, but they're on the team sheet.
lines.seed_wrong: I played it your way, {player}, and the result was worse. No complaint, it's only the score.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I have a minute, {player}? I held the line, and then afterwards my hands wouldn't stop shaking. They still haven't, quite.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us down, every one. Sit with me and let's go through it in order, calmly, the way I'd review a match.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first casualty, and holding that line was my job. I'll own it, {player}, I'd rather own it than pretend.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In, out, and everybody standing at the end. That's a clean match, {player}, and they don't come often.
lines.talk_development: A question for you, {player}, if you'll allow it. Have I changed? Last night I sat down at the fire before anybody waved me over.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: My manner with {name} has been too sharp, {player}. I talk to people like I'm officiating when I'm tired, and they don't deserve it.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me straight, please. Does {name} actually like me, or am I just the one who carries the packs?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I disagree about nearly everything, {player}. But when it's bad, they're the first name I'd write on the sheet, and I don't understand it.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't right tonight, {player}. They ate last, and that's usually me.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: A word, {player}, and I'll be fair about it. The first pick of the gear lands with {name} every time. Maybe there's a reason, but I'd like to hear it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll be plain, {player}. {name} and I don't get on, and pretending we do is making it worse for everyone.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going in without a plan to get out, {player}. I've seen squads lose like that, and I'd rather we didn't.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I read {name} wrongly, {player}, and I want to correct the record properly. They called it right and I called it wrong.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: A fair question, {player}, asked calmly. On the hard ones, I'm left behind. Is that about my play, or something else?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit was passed to {name} and nobody consulted me. I'd have surrendered it gladly, {player}, if somebody had only asked.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, that settles me a little. I'll go and count the packs.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: It'll pass, it always does. Give me until morning.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: Not the call I hoped for, but I'll respect it. I'll take a walk round the camp.
lines.talk_lands_development: So it isn't only me who's noticed. Then I wasn't imagining the fire.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, I can't tell from the inside. Ask me again in a month.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, I don't think that's it, {player}. You've misread the play there.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: That's fair, and {name} and I will sit down calmly, with nobody else around.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Possibly, I don't know. People don't come with a rulebook, unfortunately.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Strike that from the record, please, and not a word to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, I'll accept that, properly. A bit bruised, but fair.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've noted it, {player}, and I'll sleep on the decision.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the decision, then. Thank you for being clear about it.
lines.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that one for tonight, I think. I'll be at the fire.
lines.arc_cracks: Tonight I sat down at the fire before anybody asked me, {player}. Nobody said anything, and somebody passed me the bread.
lines.arc_turn: For three years I waited at the edge for the wave, {player}. I think I was waiting for permission nobody had to give.
lines.arc_become: I belong here, everyone, and I didn't earn it, you just let me in. I've stopped waiting at the edge, properly this time.
lines.arc_failed: I still stand at the edge and wait, {player}, out of habit. Walking up without being asked is beyond me, it seems.
lines.alt_turn: Somebody went down today, {player}, and I can't stop seeing it. Twenty one years on a pitch and nobody ever died in front of me.
lines.alt_become: I'll hold the line, I always will. But I'm tired in a way sleep doesn't fix, and I'd rather you knew.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the worst squad for following a plan that I've ever seen, everyone. I'd play every match with you.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, and help each other. We went down together, and we get up together, that's the rule now.
lines.g_toast_after: To all of you, who sat me down before I asked. I don't wait at the edge any more, and that's because of you.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my squad now, permanently. I'll still give the plan once, but I don't have to hold it up alone.
g_quiet_line_after: I walked straight up to the fire tonight and sat down. Nobody looked up, and that was the best part.
One day we'll play a proper match out here, everyone, twenty two of us. I've decided it's not a silly thing to want.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and this time I'll just say thank you and leave it there. I'm learning how.
That's kind, and I believe you. The packs can stay unchecked tonight.

history.open: You've seen me pat my pocket, {player}. The whistle's there. Twelve seasons in the Segunda Division and nine before that in the regional leagues, and I landed here with nothing else.

options.reply: Only in a fight, never for anything else. A whistle should mean something, otherwise people stop listening to it.

options.text: A referee. That explains a lot.
options.reply: People say that, and they're usually right. I tell the plan once and expect you to listen, and I'm told it's a bit much.
I was right more often than I was liked, which is the job. Once I needed a police escort out of a ground for a correct penalty.

history.open: In Astranaar people bring me their arguments, {player}. A hide, a cot, a fence. Nobody planned it, it just happened, and now there's a queue some mornings.

options.reply: Because I listen to both sides and I don't pick the one I like. That's all it is. It's rarer than it should be.
Half of them leave angry, every time. When both sides grumble, it was usually fair.

history.open: My father was a postman, {player}, and my mother worked in a dry cleaner's. They had me late. He drove two hours to Burgos to watch my first Segunda match, and he was gone eight months later. She went the year after.

options.text: That's a lot in two years.
options.reply: It was, and I worked straight through it. Every Saturday, half of every Sunday. I'm not sure I recommend that.
He sat in the stand with his hands behind his back, like this. That's where I got it. I didn't notice until much later.

friend.open: I was engaged once, {player}, to Elena, for three years. She said I was never there at weekends, and that I talked to her like I was officiating. She was right about both, and I've never said that to anybody.

options.text: Do you still think about her?
options.reply: Sometimes, and kindly now. Mostly I think about how long it took me to see she was right. That's the part I'd change.

options.text: You don't talk to me like that.
options.reply: No, I don't, do I? I've been trying. It's good to hear somebody noticed.

sworn.open: I spent twenty one years being the one in the middle that nobody was on the side of, {player}. I'm on your side, without conditions. I've never said that to anybody, and I wanted to say it properly.

options.reply: Then that's settled, and I won't need the whistle with you. I'll keep it in my pocket anyway, out of habit.
No, not with you. That's the strangest freedom I've ever had, and I like it.

reconciled.open: {name} and I sat down and sorted it out properly, both sides heard. It's settled, and I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: Thank you, {player}, it's easier to travel without that hanging over us.
Nobody, which is the funny part. We managed it ourselves, like adults.
